title: Transform & load into Postgres
summary: The transform worker role: typed transformers per data_type and an idempotent bulk loader into partitioned tables.
goal: Staged batches become rows in day-partitioned telemetry tables idempotently, and an automated end-to-end test proves the whole pipeline from HTTP to Postgres.
success_criteria: metrics, events and logs tables are partitioned by day with partition pruning.
One transformer per data_type behind a common trait, each thoroughly table-tested.
Re-loading any staged file never duplicates rows.
An e2e test sends 1,000 records in and checks every stage's counts.
rust_learning_outcomes: Integration tests and the lib + bin crate pattern
out_of_scope: Query API for consumers of the data
Schema migrations of telemetry payloads across versions

stories.title: Transformer trait & one transformer per data_type
